subhead: The Log Cabin mic is done. Monday nights there are over, for good. We are looking for the next room.

host.heading: Host the next one.
host.body: If you run a bar, a brewery, a coffee shop, or any public space that wants a comedy open mic, tell us. We run the night. You bring the room.
